title: Umbrella Network — Staking Underflow Exploit Analysis
root_cause: Missing underflow check in the `withdraw(amount)` function during `_balances[user] - amount` computation, allowing any address with zero staked balance to withdraw large amounts
other_code:
Attacker (0x1751e3...)
    │
    ├─[1] No staked balance
    │       _balances[attacker] = 0
    │
    ├─[2] Calls StakingRewards.withdraw(8,792,873,290,680,252,648,282)
    │       ⚡ Underflow triggered:
    │       _balances[attacker] = 0 - 8,792,873,290,680,252,648,282
    │                           = type(uint256).max - 8,792...282 + 1
    │                           = enormous positive value
    │
    ├─[3] Contract transfers 8,792... UniLP to attacker
    │       (entire LP balance held by contract can be drained)
    │
    └─[4] Loss: ~$700,000 UniLP
